plan.objective: Test three fair strategies for gaining useful information with weak units and preserving their future information opportunities.

designs.lifetime: Bounded costs for Scouts/Sergeants initiating known losing attacks or newly entering disclosed lethal reach. Preserve their opportunity for a later new disclosure; no reward merely for sacrificing. Other tactical value can override the cost.
designs.objectives: Route expendable Scouts/Sergeants/Lieutenants to uncertain Flag-region screens supported by an accessible combat unit/Miner. Uses public candidate masks and weak positional priors, not true Flag position.
designs.followthrough: Charge expendable hidden-target attacks an information-opportunity budget. Credit only conditional attack/abstention decisions robust to one enemy response, including escape, loss of beneficiary, recapture, and terminal Flag loss.

plan.fairness: Same eight sampled worlds, depth four, correction blend, strategic utility and root context as baseline. Only the selected public-root scoring module changes. No diagnostic-truth, enemy setup, layout label, referee ranks, new fitted model or source changes after freeze. Miners and Spies are not expendable investigators.
plan.comparison: Every DOS matchup in a cohort shares exact armies and move seeds. Each pair swaps sides. Direct fair head-to-head against the unchanged Context Teacher uses another cohort seed, shared across the three candidates.
plan.analysis: Win=1 draw=0.5 loss=0; errors excluded and retained. Stratified bootstrap of complete paired blocks within layout families, 20000 resamples. Report 95% intervals plus 98.3333% Bonferroni intervals across three strategy comparisons per endpoint. Primary final comparison is matched DOS score difference versus baseline; a reliable general improvement also needs direct predecessor score interval above 50%. No candidate selection or tuning after pilot; validate all three unchanged. Analysis seed 1970001.
plan.behavior: Replay physical outcomes only after games. Track initial-square identities of weak ranks5/6/8. Count new enemy rank disclosures personally caused by attack or defense, weak casualties with no lifetime disclosure, known losing attacks, surviving disclosed targets, Miner losses. Report scored games separately from error prefixes. No-disclosure deaths are descriptive and may be justified defense/tempo. Per-game paired behavior differences and raw ratios accompany strength results.
plan.scope: These are desktop strategic pilots, not production promotion. No X16 feasibility or human-strength claim. Results against DOS retain its original privileged information and unscored fatal paths. Existing production and registered policies remain immutable.
